In recent times, 2020Vision continues to remain current, through both the main label & its exciting new sub-label; Editions - combining intelligent leftfield electronic music from the likes of Doubting Thomas & Photonz, with exciting dance floor house music from the likes of Denney & Mekanism.

snippet.title: Silver City - La Seine
snippet.description:
Subscribe: http://bit.ly/Subscribe2020Vision
Get It: https://www.beatport.com/release/sounds-like-summer-vol-3/2359013
Since we're all getting used to living in the sunshine these days we thought it was the right time to serve up a selection that just makes you feel good in the heat. 
We've spent time digging through the crates to find some lost gems and forgotten classics that sound as good today as they did back then. 
Sounds Like Summer Vol 3 features an eclectic mix of Downtempo, Disco, Deep House and Balearic Beats with music from Crazy P, Maya Jane Coles, 2020Soundsystem, Deadbeats, Debukas, Silver City and many more.

snippet.title: Stuart Prentice - 20:20 Vision Mix 1 (Groovin') - January 2022
snippet.description:
Originally uploaded to Mixcloud - https://www.mixcloud.com/stuartprentice/stuart-prentice-2020-vision-mix-1-groovin-january-2022/

Legendary Leeds label 20:20 Vision has a vast catalogue of releases as you would expect with an outfit going since 1995. There are so many tracks I love and have great memories of I decided to do two mixes. This one focusses on deeper, funkin’, late-night house & techno spanning from the labels early days, right through to more recent times. It's hard to put in words what a huge influence 20:20 has been on me so I'll let the music do the talking...

2. BRS – Catch The Boat (Fthing Stereo Mix) (VIS045/2000)
3. Alton Miller & Urban Farmers ‎– Lolita (The Rhubarb Triangle Mix) (VIS012/1996)

In recent times, 2020Vision continues to remain current, through both the main label & its exciting new sub-label; Editions - combining intelligent leftfield electronic music from the likes of Doubting Thomas & Photonz, with exciting dance floor house music from the likes of Denney & Mekanism.
